Any reference or link that you establish to the BEA Web site must not contain information that suggests such an endorsement or recommendation by BEA. Similarly, any link that BEA determines should be placed on its official Web site will not contain information that endorses or recommends a referenced organization. Further, the BEA site does not accept advertising or provide promotional materials or services of any kind.
